## COMPARISON EVIDENCE

### EVIDENCE

- [filings/bodies/45ecdd60b95ea64e.txt] "Total debt, including current portion 16,865 10,353" — leverage rose materially after the 2026 balance-sheet step-up versus year-end 2025.  
- [filings/bodies/45ecdd60b95ea64e.txt] "Cash and cash equivalents $ 740 $ 599" — liquidity improved modestly versus 31 Dec 2025 but remains small relative to total debt.  
- [filings/bodies/45ecdd60b95ea64e.txt] "Goodwill 25,002 17,762" — goodwill and acquisition-related intangibles dominate the post-deal capital structure.  
- [filings/bodies/c08a7e1183c9815a.txt] "Net cash provided by operating activities was $976 million and Free cash flow 1 was $862 million" — Q3 2026 operating cash generation on a company-adjusted FCF basis.  
- [filings/bodies/0b24b28f0619f894.txt] "10,677 $ 10,127 $ 9,831 Banking Solutions" — reported revenue progression across recent fiscal years (Banking segment line).  
- [filings/bodies/0b24b28f0619f894.txt] "Risk Factors In addition to the normal risks of business, we are subject to significant risks and uncertainties, including those listed below" — formal risk-factor framing in the annual filing.  
- [filings/bodies/0b24b28f0619f894.txt] "Issuer Solutions Acquisition On January 31, 2024, we completed the sale (the "2024 Worldpay Sale") of a 55% equity interest" — portfolio reshape and Issuer Solutions transaction context.

### NUMBERS

- Screen key FCF (Yahoo/TTM-based) | 2446874880.0 | screen snapshot (not PP&E-only statutory) | [snapshots/20260725T101234Z.json]  

**Reconciliation (screen vs filings):** `snapshots/20260725T101234Z.json` shows **strong_buy** with **adjusted_signal: strong_buy** (no pre-research downgrade). Screen **FCF ~$2.45bn** matches SEC continuing **OCF $2.608bn − PP&E capex $154m**. `screening_snapshot.json` / Yahoo also show **consolidated FCF $1.827bn** and **TTM FCF $1.921bn**, which embed broader capex and differ from statutory PP&E-only FCF. Dividend-family passes remain **consistent with FY2025 filing cover (~2.9× on statutory FCF; >2× on Yahoo FCF)**—no below-1.0× tension at the annual filing cut-off. **P/E 7.8** and earnings-family passes are **not filing-aligned** with volatile quarterly GAAP EPS (e.g. Yahoo Q1 2026 diluted EPS **4.58** on a large equity-method item in `financials_annual.json`).

### THESIS BREAKS

- FY continuing statutory FCF (SEC OCF−PP&E capex) falls below common dividends paid for a full year, with no credible adjustment narrative in the supplied filings.  
- Reported total debt rises further or refinancing terms deteriorate while cash remains in the high-hundreds of millions against multi-billion current maturities (per interim balance sheets).  
- Goodwill/intangible impairment or integration charges materially impair equity after the goodwill step-up to ~$25bn (Sep 2026 10-Q).  
- A disclosed regulatory or litigation matter in subsequent filings requires material restatement or sustained margin compression not reflected in the supplied period.
